summary: Push without a remote offers Publish / Add remote; GitHub avatars
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `32018ce`: Push with no remote offers Publish to GitHub / Add remote by URL, then pushes; GitHub avatar in Settings and on your commits in All Commits (Avatar control, fetched without the token); Repositories tool window renamed Projects (tool-window action ids now come from the stable Id)
- DevHub-Plugins `f678130`: Push with no remote offers Publish to GitHub / Add remote by URL, then pushes; GitHub avatar in Settings and on your commits in All Commits (Avatar control, fetched without the token); Repositories tool window renamed Projects (tool-window action ids now come from the stable Id)
